My Salutations to all Pious Souls....

The holy festival of Navratri is a festival for performing spiritual practice. It is the festival to awaken Ambamata (Kundalini energy) right within ourselves; it is the festival for worshipping the female element. It is the festival to develop the female element's 9 qualities in these 9 days of Navratri.

Prior to worshipping any power (female energy), it is necessary for us to have a feeling of reverence and respect towards that power in our mind. If we do not revere women, do not respect women in our life, do not accept them as female energy, but consider them to be a thing of enjoyment, then we will never be able to worship the female energy - first of all, we will have to rise above the physical level. During the 9 days of Navratri, daily worshipping the nine different forms of energy, gives us the inspiration about what feeling we should have towards the female element. We should remain with this very feeling of inspiration not just during Navratri, but throughout our life.

Navratri - where the female element is awakened in males, which balances them; on the other hand, it also reminds women of their own qualities. Today, we will discuss those qualities which men worship to increase those qualities within themselves; whereas on the other hand, women feel/become aware of those qualities within themselves. In

(2)
reality, the Navratri festival is a festival of qualities, in the 9 days, our chitta goes onto those 9 qualities of the female element. Prior to performing any kind of worship, it is absolutely necessary for the chitta to be holy and pure.

First Female Quality of the Female Element -: The first quality of the female energy is introspection about what is the situation in the present time, what can be done by remaining in this present time, what is appropriate to do. The female element is never in the imaginary world; in reality, it knows what is possible.

Second Female Quality of the Female Element is-: To live a disciplined life, this is the second quality of the female energy. This is because this quality means to remain disciplined in daily life and perform all the work on time. She herself lives a disciplined life, and also inspires her family members to live a disciplined life. Hence, generally in all houses, it is the women who do the job of waking everyone up early in the morning.

Third Female Quality of the Female Element is-: To live a contented and satisfied life - satisfaction is a very big quality of the female element. The female element is always satisfied. Whatever she has received now, she remains satisfied, happy with that, always remains joyful - these are female qualities. That's why, she manages to make others contented and satisfied.

(3)
Fourth Female Quality of the Female Element is-: Creativity - absorb any quality and then increase it - this is part of her innate/basic nature. She always keeps getting creative, artistic thoughts. What can be created from this? She ideates about that, and she actually creates that too.

Fifth Female Quality of the Female Element is-: (Self) Control is the fifth quality of the female element. She maintains (self) control under all situations, and leads a controlled/austere life. No matter how cranky her child is, she always remains in control and nurtures it, raises it - all this is possible only because of her (self) controlled nature.

Sixth Female Quality of Female Element is-: The primary feeling of the female element is the sense of faith. The amount of feeling of faith that a woman has, it is because of that itself that she can completely and unconditionally surrender, and she can also attain the high peak on the spiritual path. The path of yoginis and their collective, is an example of this very feeling. During my childhood itself when I had to go to different places - today, I remember one such place where I had gone and got good meditation. And I had stayed there for some days and performed spiritual practice continually - that place was the Temple of 64 Yoginis, which is situated at Bhedaghat on the banks of the Narmada River. I had gone there from Jabalpur. Earlier, there used to be a collective of sorcerers and occultists who would come there to obtain spiritual powers from the 64 Yoginis by making them happy.

(4)
Seventh Female Quality of Female Element is-: To love one's own self - this is a big quality of the female element. She loves her own self. Meaning, that one who can love one person, can also love many people; because one who does not love one's own self, if that person does not have love within his/her own self, then how can that person give to others what he himself/herself does not have?

Eighth Female Quality of the Female Element is-: The main quality of the female element is the feeling of affection/motherliness. Today, it is because this feeling is present, that the world is functioning; and that is why, women are considered to be the idols of affection/motherliness. The female element can never be cruel.

Nineth Female Quality of Female Element is-: Inspiring others is an important quality of the female element. The work of inspiring many poets, writers, soldiers has happened through the female element. That's why, it is said that behind every successful man there is a woman herself who is providing inspiration. The doer is the man himself, but the person who makes him do it, is the energy of the female element; that is why, the female element is called the activating energy.

These nine qualities about which I have told you, are those of the female element; and this element is found both in men and in women. Some have less of it and some more, because it is not related to the

(5)
gender (of a person). Whichever Gurus are there, the female element is found to be more in them.

And because of this reason, they manage to completely, unconditionally surrender to Paramatma; and then, the event of giving birth to a soul, meaning, self-realisation happens through them. That's why, the Guru is called Maooli.

I pray to God that the female element in all of you may be awakened during this Navratri.

Lots of special blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
